root: ^Richard Bekely looked over his shoulder, about to make the turn and caught his son's deathly gaze from the back seat.
^Alex looked like a convict on the way to prison. His eyes seethed, restless, dead.
^What was up with him? Why was he like this?
^Behind him a yellowish brand of sunlight illuminated the tarmac, tall boxy hedges, and cedar tree standing arbitrary and alone in one of the gardens. Tick, tick, tick went the indicator.
